data.name: Charlie
data.message: Hey Diana, just checking cameras here.

I just walked into security from electrical, and I found Charlie dead right there on the floor. Diana was standing right next to the body when I walked in! It has to be Diana, she was literally right on top of him. I say we vote her out right now.

I started my round up north, moving from weapons to the cafeteria. Honestly, I didn't see a single soul the entire time, so I was completely isolated and can't vouch for anyone's whereabouts. 

Bob, that's a pretty massive accusation. If you caught Diana literally standing on the body in security, that's incredibly suspicious, but we definitely need to hear her side of the story before we jump the gun. Diana, what's your defense? Did you just walk in on it too, or are you saying Bob killed Charlie and self-reported? 

Since I was nowhere near security, I don't have the missing puzzle pieces here. Let's hear what Diana has to say, and if anyone else was near electrical or navigation to corroborate either story, speak up now. I'll hold my vote until we hear from Diana.

I started my round over in the upper engine and then moved up to oxygen to do my tasks. I haven't seen a single person this whole time, so I was completely isolated on the left side of the ship and can't confirm anything that happened over by security. 

Bob, your accusation against Diana is huge, but like Frank said, we really need to hear Diana's side of the story before we lock in any votes. It's basically a 50/50 right now — either Diana was caught red-handed, or Bob just killed Charlie and self-reported to frame her. Diana, what exactly were you doing in security? Let's hear your defense, and I'd like to hear if Alice saw anything on that side of the map as well. I'm holding my vote until then.

I started off in the cafeteria, moved down to medbay, and I had just arrived in electrical right before the meeting was called. I haven't seen a single person this entire round. 

Bob, you mentioned you walked into security *from* electrical. I didn't see you in electrical at all. It's possible you headed into the hallway to security right before I got there, but I figure it's worth noting that my path was totally clear. 

Since Frank, Eve, and I were all on completely different parts of the ship, this is entirely a 1v1 between Bob and Diana. Diana, you're up next. We need your side of the story immediately. Did you just walk in on the body? Did Bob kill Charlie and self-report? I'm not voting until I hear your defense, and I suggest we all listen closely to see whose story makes more sense.

"Whoa, Bob, nice try. Here's exactly what happened: I was coming down from weapons into security. Literally the second I stepped into the room, I saw Charlie's body on the floor. I was standing there for maybe half a second processing it, about to hit the report button, and Bob beat me to it. 

But Alice just caught you in a massive lie, Bob. Alice, thank you for speaking up. You said you were just in electrical and didn't see Bob at all. That's because Bob didn't 'just walk in from electrical' — he was already in security because he killed Charlie! 

Bob killed Charlie, saw me walk in from weapons, and panic self-reported to control the narrative and frame the first person he saw. This is a classic self-report. It's a 1v1 between us, but Alice's testimony proves Bob is lying about his route. I'm voting Bob, and if you guys want to get a Duck out right now, you should too."

Alice, you just said you arrived in electrical *right before* the meeting was called. I passed through electrical earlier, moving straight to security. By the time you got to electrical, I was already in security finding Charlie's body, which is why you didn't see me. Diana's story is entirely fabricated. She claims she just walked in, but she was standing directly over him doing nothing until I entered and reported. She's the Duck and is trying to use a slight timing gap to frame me. This is a clear 1v1. I'm voting Diana, and you all should too if you want to win.

This is a classic 1v1, so we have to pick a side. 

Alice, while your information about electrical is good, Bob's explanation actually makes perfect sense. If you only just arrived in electrical right before the meeting, Bob had more than enough time to pass through it earlier and already be in security. 

What's really catching my attention, though, is Frank's testimony. Frank, you said you started in weapons and didn't see a single soul before moving to cafeteria. But Diana claims she came down from weapons into security. If she was in weapons at the start of the round with you, you probably should have seen her. 

Since Frank and Bob both seem aligned against Diana, and Diana's weapons story has a slight hole in it, I'm going to side with Bob on this one. If we're wrong and Diana is a Goose, then we immediately vote out Bob next round. Let's resolve this 1v1. I'm voting Diana.

Diana

Eve is absolutely right about the timeline. Diana, you jumped on my testimony way too hard to try and "prove" Bob was lying. I explicitly stated that I had *just* arrived in electrical right before the meeting. It's completely reasonable that Bob passed through there before I arrived, so my not seeing him doesn't actually incriminate him. Trying to twist my words to clear yourself makes you look more suspicious, honestly.

Combine that with Frank being in weapons and not seeing you, and your story is definitely the weaker of the two. 

Since this is a hard 1v1 and Frank and Eve have already cast their votes for Diana, her fate is sealed anyway. I'm going to vote Diana to secure this. 

But listen closely, everyone: we are resolving a 1v1. If Diana gets ejected and the game DOES NOT end, Bob is 100% the Duck who self-reported. If we wake up and the game is still going, whoever finds a button first needs to press it immediately so we can vote out Bob. 

Diana

"You guys are making a massive mistake falling for Bob's lies. Frank, we obviously just missed each other in weapons — I moved out right at the start of the round. Alice, I wasn't twisting your words, I genuinely thought your timing cleared me and condemned him! But fine, since you've all already made up your minds and cast your votes, there's nothing I can do. Just remember this: when the game DOES NOT end after I'm gone, Bob is 100% the Duck who self-reported. Do exactly what Alice said and press the button on Bob immediately next round. Good luck, Geese."

Bob
